change: Append version-3 assembler resource summaries; original instructions are unchanged.
resource_policy: Every helper conservatively reserves v0..v6 and x0..x31. Its own fixed LDS stack is 4 bytes if it pushes sp, otherwise 0. The six source call edges are retained for link-time stack aggregation. No private or static local storage is used.
scope: Compatibility of work-item builtins only; arbitrary kernel instructions still need validation on the chosen RTL.
